title: Inside the White Cube
summary: A trivial coloured square becomes 'art' the instant the browser's Fullscreen API deletes every scrap of worldly context around it.
mechanism: Fullscreen API strips all browser/OS chrome on demand, enacting the white cube's context-erasure; fullscreenchange toggles the 'Now it is art' verdict, with a faux-cube fallback when the request is refused; per-visit hue via Math.random.
references: Brian O'Doherty, Inside the White Cube: The Ideology of the Gallery Space (1976)
net.art (browser chrome / Fullscreen API as material)
